bindings.scope_section_quote: The Cummins Range MRE is expected to have reasonable prospects for eventual economic extraction (RPEEE) on the following basis: • the resource is situated in a favourable mining jurisdiction, with no known impediments to land access or tenure status; • the volume, orientation and grade of the resource is amenable to mining extraction via open pit or underground mining methods; • preliminary metallurgical test work shows extraction and concentration of rare earths and phosphate can be achieved with traditional processing techniques; and • an enhanced Scoping Study was completed in August 2023
